title: Quietly Creamy Turkish Lamb Iskender
description: A kid-friendly Turkish dish featuring lamb, breadcrumbs, and a creamy sauce, with a hint of bitterness from the yuzu cure, this dish is kosher-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together yuzu juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb strips to the bowl and toss to coat with the yuzu mixture.
Let the lamb marinate for 10 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the marinade and cook in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned.
Transfer the lamb to a baking dish and bake in the oven for 10 minutes.
While the lamb is cooking, toast the breadcrumbs in a small skillet over medium heat until lightly browned.
In a small saucepan, heat the heavy cream over medium heat until warmed through.
To assemble the dish, slice the cooked lamb into thin strips and serve over toasted breadcrumbs, topped with the warmed cream sauce.
